sessions.phase_label: Manuscript editing and initial illustration decisions
Paperback interior formatting, review, and publishing-service planning
Final interior corrections, cover preparation, and publication metadata

requirements.title: Manuscript Editorial Polish
requirements.definition: Polish the manuscript's grammar, sentence flow, repetition, readability, and expression while retaining the author's intended meaning and personal voice.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the coherent editorial-polishing mechanism, including proofreading and approved sentence rewrites; incorporation of later client-authored revisions is tracked separately because it has its own failure and correction trajectory.

requirements.title: Client Revision Integration
requirements.definition: Ensure the final manuscript incorporates the client's latest approved additions and removals, including dedication and other client-edited content.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers preservation of the authoritative client content rather than general copyediting; individual paragraphs and dedication edits are values within this content-integration mechanism.

requirements.title: Title Page Content and Layout
requirements.definition: Present the book title, subtitle, and author name correctly on the title page without formatting artifacts and with the client-approved visual hierarchy.
requirements.boundary_note: Limited to title-page text and hierarchy; cover design, chapter-heading styles, and copyright-page formatting are independently evolving artifacts.

requirements.title: Chapter Heading and Subtitle Formatting
requirements.definition: Format chapter titles, subtitles, and associated heading text consistently, including capitalization, line hierarchy, and the table-of-contents presentation of headings.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the reusable chapter-heading style system; page numbering, title-page hierarchy, callout styling, and paragraph density can be changed or fail independently.

requirements.title: Mama's Hot Take Styling
requirements.definition: Apply the client-selected typography and quotation treatment to text under the recurring Mama's Hot Take sections.
requirements.boundary_note: This recurring callout has its own typography and quotation rules, separate from chapter headings and general editorial proofreading.

requirements.title: Page Density and Paragraph Spacing
requirements.definition: Control paragraph spacing and page density so the interior remains readable while preserving the concise, cost-conscious layout selected for the current edition.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated because the client explicitly considered and deferred a spacing change while other formatting corrections remained active.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Editorial Fit
requirements.definition: Review chapter illustrations, including AI-generated images, for suitability to the book's tone, chapter meaning, and colour-palette consistency.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers semantic and aesthetic suitability of selected illustrations; technical placement, sizing, cropping, and resolution are independently testable.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Placement and Quality
requirements.definition: Place the supplied illustration at the beginning of each chapter using the selected full-page treatment while avoiding stretching, cropping, corner artifacts, and pixelation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers technical chapter-image layout and rendering quality; image editorial fit and the exterior cover are separate Requirements with different acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Page Numbering and Table of Contents
requirements.definition: Add page numbers and ensure the table of contents reflects the final pagination and chapter structure after the interior size and formatting are fixed.
requirements.boundary_note: Page numbering and TOC page references form one tightly coupled mechanism; chapter typography and trim-size selection remain separate inputs.

requirements.title: Copyright Page Content and Presentation
requirements.definition: Maintain the client-approved copyright-page alignment and metadata, including publisher attribution, contact information, and ISBN.
requirements.boundary_note: Publisher line, email, ISBN, and alignment are attributes of one independently maintained copyright-page artifact rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Paperback Trim Size
requirements.definition: Prepare the paperback around the client-selected trim size, provisionally specified as 5.5 by 8.5 inches, so dependent interior and cover dimensions can be finalized.
requirements.boundary_note: Trim size is a shared format constraint rather than a generic formatting Requirement; image placement, pagination, and cover production remain independently testable.

requirements.title: Paperback Cover Design
requirements.definition: Create or improve a paperback-ready cover containing the necessary title and author details and compatible with the finalized book dimensions.
requirements.boundary_note: The exterior cover is separate from the interior title page and chapter illustrations because it has trim- and spine-dependent production requirements and a distinct service trajectory.

requirements.title: Back Matter and Author Copy
requirements.definition: Write the requested back matter or back-cover content together with concise author information for the publication package.
requirements.boundary_note: Back content and author lines are treated as one bundled copywriting deliverable; their exact placement as interior back matter versus exterior back-cover copy remains unclear.

requirements.title: KDP Metadata and Upload Support
requirements.definition: Prepare the needed KDP submission content, including keywords, and guide the client through entering the information and uploading the paperback from the client's computer.
requirements.boundary_note: Keyword preparation and guided upload are tightly coupled steps in the accepted KDP-submission service; general publishing advice and creation of publication artifacts remain separate.

requirements.title: Paperback Publishing Guidance
requirements.definition: Advise the first-time author on the steps and materials needed to publish the manuscript successfully as a self-published paperback.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested advisory deliverable covering publication-readiness questions; concrete cover, back-copy, interior, and KDP-upload work are represented by narrower Requirements.
